subject: PO metadata, release windows and discount routing for BiomedCo deployment
messages:
From: Angela Park <angela.procurement@biomedco.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: PO metadata + invoice cadence question for Redwood deployment

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team is excited to move forward. Procurement has two quick asks that will determine how we structure the purchase order and whether the commercial team can apply the quoted discount:

1) Mandatory PO fields: our AP system requires PO Number, Billing address, Remit-to, BU/Cost center, and GL account code on every invoice. Can you confirm Redwood can include a machine-readable PO header (PO#, MSA ID and customer BU) on each invoice?

2) Invoice cadence vs discounts: BiomedCo prefers monthly invoices (in arrears) with net45 payment terms. The buyer told me some discounts you offered on the quote were conditional on quarterly billing or prepay. Please confirm whether the 12-month commit discount is valid with monthly/net45, or whether it changes.

3) Release windows: for multi-entity setups we may need a PO per legal entity or a single consolidated PO with release windows. Can you advise your preference/limitations?

We can send a draft PO once we confirm the above. Also attaching our internal PO template for reference.

Thanks,
Angela Park
Senior Procurement Manager
BiomedCo
attachments: BiomedCo_PO_Template.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Angela Park <angela.procurement@biomedco.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO metadata + invoice cadence question for Redwood deployment

Hi Angela — great to hear. Short answers up front then I’ll loop in finance for a couple of specifics:

- PO header: yes — we can include PO#, Master Agreement ID, and a customer billing reference on every invoice. We can also emit a CSV feed for AP reconciliation if your system can consume it.
- Discounts: the quoted 12-month commit discount is configurable by invoice cadence. In practice we typically offer a stronger rate for prepaid/quarterly billing versus monthly/net45. I’ve asked Finance to confirm precise bands (see Vivek/Marissa CC).
- Release windows / multi-entity: we support both models. A single consolidated PO with clear release windows and the consolidated billing reference is easiest for our billing team; separate POs per legal entity are supported but will require mapping on our side (additional invoice lines).

I’m attaching our PO template and standard Master Services Schedule so you can compare fields. If you can share the draft PO (even a stub) we’ll validate field mapping and confirm the discount code that must appear on the PO.

Next steps: Vivek will propose the pricing routing (how the discount applies by cadence) and Marissa will confirm the finance constraints for net45/monthly.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood_PO_Template.xlsx (xlsx); MSS_Redwood_Standard.pdf (pdf)

Thanks Angela — quick pricing/ops clarity from my side so you have concrete options to share with your AP. High level: the commercial discount is a function of three levers — commitment length, billing cadence, and payment terms.

Proposal (options):
- Option A (preferred, maximum discount): 12-month committed value, quarterly invoicing in arrears OR annual prepay -> 11% off list. Requires consolidated billing and PO reference to MSA-2026-112 and Discount Code DN-12M-11 on PO and invoices.
- Option B (mid): 12-month committed value, monthly invoicing in arrears, net45 -> 9% off list. This accommodates your net45 preference but discount is lower due to receivables risk and extra billing ops.
- Option C (flex): 12-month committed value, monthly invoices with early-pay (5 days) incremental discount of 1% on top of Option B if you can support 5-day EFT.

PO language to ensure automated routing and discount: please include the following on the PO header and each invoice line: 
- Master Agreement ID: MSA-2026-112
- Redwood Billing ID: RED-84321
- Discount Code: DN-12M-11 (or DN-12M-9 if selecting Option B)
- Billing frequency: MONTHLY or QUARTERLY (spell out cadence)

Operational notes:
- If you submit separate POs per legal entity, please add the BU code and designate which PO maps to which legal entity. We will map invoices to the PO you reference; without a clear mapping our system will flag for manual reconciliation.
- For Net45 we can accept the term but Marissa flagged the need for a credit approval form for discounts >8% (this is standard).

If you can confirm Option A or B we’ll produce a final pricing line item list and generate a DocuSign SOW/PO acknowledgement link.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Hi all — finance here with the compliance constraints and what we require to honor a discount. TL;DR: we can support net45 and monthly invoices, but discounts >8% require a completed Credit Approval Checklist and explicit Discount Approval Form attached to the contract/PO.

Required PO fields (must be present exactly as shown on the PO header):
- PO Number
- Bill-to name and full billing address
- Remit-to (if different)
- Legal Entity / BU Code / Cost Center
- GL Account (if your ERP requires it; otherwise map to our default)
- Master Agreement ID (MSA-2026-112)
- Discount Code (DN-12M-11 or DN-12M-9)

Invoice timing & cadence:
- Monthly invoices in arrears: we invoice on the 1st business day following month close, with a 30-day due date by default. Net45 can be accommodated but requires credit approval for discounts >8%.
- Quarterly invoices: invoiced within 7 business days after quarter close. Quarterly/annual prepay options reduce billing ops and qualify for the top discount band.

Discount mechanics:
- The discount must be called out on the PO (Discount Code line) and repeated on the invoice line. If the discount is applied post-invoice (credit memo) it must reference the invoice number and PO.
- For multi-entity POs we need one canonical PO field indicating consolidated billing OR per-entity PO numbers. If consolidated, please include the list of member entities as an appendix to the PO.

Attachments for internal processing: we need a signed Discount_Approval_Form.pdf and a completed Credit_Approval_Checklist.xlsx before we can lock the DN-12M-11 code to your account. I’ve attached both for your convenience.

If you want to proceed with Option B (monthly/net45 at 9%) we can start the credit approval flow and issue a DocuSign SOW for signature.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
attachments: Discount_Approval_Form.pdf (pdf); Credit_Approval_Checklist.xlsx (xlsx)
